questions.question: Why did Naboth refuse to sell his vineyard to King Ahab?

answers.text: The king's offer was too low
He had promised it to his son

questions.question: Ahab's wife Jezebel plotted against Naboth with two men. What did she have them accuse him of?

answers.text: Cursing both God and the king

questions.question: After King Ahab took Naboth's vineyard, what did God tell Elijah to say would happen to Ahab?

answers.text: Dogs would lick up his blood where they licked Naboth's
Naboth's sons would take back their land from him
Fire would burn down his palace in Jezreel

questions.question: When King Ahab humbled himself before God after Elijah's warning, what did God say about the coming calamity?

answers.text: It would come on his house in his son's days
It would never come on his house at all
It would fall only on Jezebel instead
